What is Blended Finance?

Blended finance has mobilized approximately $231 billion in capital towards sustainable development in developing countries to-date.

Blended finance transactions range considerably in size, from a minimum of $110,000 to a maximum of $8 billion.

The median blended finance transaction has been $64 million in total size (2010-2018).

There remains an estimated $4.2 trillion funding gap per annum to realize the SDGs in developing countries alone.

Learn more about Convergence membership for access to transaction details and investment databases.
